question: Build a peer comp table for four analog and mixed-signal semiconductor companies: Texas Instruments, Analog Devices, Microchip Technology and NXP Semiconductors. Alignment rule: for each company use its own fiscal quarter that ended between April 1, 2026 and July 31, 2026 (inclusive); do not calendarize or move any company to a different quarter. Each company has exactly one such quarter. For that quarter report, using GAAP figures from the company's SEC filings as of October 3, 2026: (1) revenue in USD millions; (2) year-over-year revenue growth in % versus the same fiscal quarter a year earlier; (3) gross margin in % = gross profit / revenue; (4) operating margin in % = GAAP operating income / revenue. Also state the fiscal quarter label and quarter-end date used for each company.
grading: Graded cell by cell: each value within tolerance and for the stated period; a missing cell counts as wrong.
answer:
Peer comp, each company's own fiscal quarter ending Apr 1-Jul 31, 2026 (GAAP):
| Row | Revenue | YoY revenue growth | Gross margin | Operating margin |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Texas Instruments (Q2 FY2026, ended 2026-06-30) | 5,463.0 | 22.82% | 61.36% | 42.28% |
| Analog Devices (Q2 FY2026, ended 2026-05-02) | 3,623.5 | 37.25% | 67.33% | 38.08% |
| Microchip Technology (Q1 FY2027, ended 2026-06-30) | 1,484.7 | 38.05% | 63.24% | 22.68% |
| NXP Semiconductors (Q2 FY2026, ended 2026-06-28) | 3,496.0 | 19.48% | 57.27% | 30.64% |
